svg.title: MaldiSuite: what each of the three packages offers
svg.desc: Animated overview of the three MaldiSuite packages, side by side and in no particular order. A spotlight moves from card to card every 9 seconds. MaldiAMRKit shows preprocessing of a raw spectrum into bins, alignment of shifted spectra, and MIC values read as resistant or susceptible against EUCAST breakpoints. MaldiBatchKit shows samples moving from clusters by acquisition site to clusters by species, kBET and LISI scores before and after correction, and correctors compared in a grid search. MaldiDeepKit shows four backbones (MLP, 1-D CNN, 1-D ResNet, 1-D ViT), predictions with uncertainty and conformal prediction sets, and a dual-branch classifier joining a spectrum and side features. All data are illustrative. Below the cards: use one, or all three, pip install maldisuite.
